findings.claim: Indonesia's President Prabowo Subianto announced in May 2026 a cut to ride-hailing platform commissions (including Grab) to a maximum of 8% of fares, down from around 20% previously; Indonesia generates about 23% of Grab's revenue and an analyst estimated 5-10% downside risk to 2026 EBITDA from the change.
findings.source: Nikkei Asia / KrASIA, "Grab faces regulatory headwinds in Indonesia, its key ride-hailing market"

findings.claim: Grab's proposed acquisition of foodpanda's Taiwan business is under review by Taiwan's Fair Trade Commission; a Taiwanese legislator publicly called the deal 'fake competition and real monopoly,' and critics raised national-security concerns tied to Grab's mapping partnership with Huawei's Petal Maps, ties to Chinese autonomous-vehicle firm WeRide, and an R&D center in Beijing.
findings.source: CommonWealth Magazine, "Grab's Taiwan Gamble: A Regulatory Gauntlet, a Subsidy War, and an Eight-Year Bet"

findings.claim: Grab and Gojek together hold over 91% of Indonesian ride-hailing; a rumoured Grab acquisition of GoTo's on-demand services has drawn antitrust scrutiny from Indonesia's competition regulator, and the Grab-GoTo merger talks have stalled amid mounting antitrust concerns over unprecedented market concentration.
findings.source: Asian Legal Business, "THE BRIEFS: Grab-GoTo merger stalls as antitrust scrutiny mounts"

findings.claim: Malaysia's Court of Appeal in March 2025 dismissed the Malaysia Competition Commission's (MyCC) appeal seeking to reinstate a proposed RM86.77 million (~US$19.5M) fine against Grab entities for alleged abuse of dominant position (restrictive driver-advertising clauses), ruling MyCC's handling of the investigation was 'cavalier'; the case originated from a 2019 investigation.
findings.source: MLex / Competition Policy International, "Grab wins Malaysian antitrust legal battle as regulator's appeal dismissed"

regulatory_antitrust.note: 多起訴訟/審查同時進行：Indonesia 傭金上限下修已生效並有具體 EBITDA 衝擊估計（負向、已實現）；Taiwan foodpanda 併購反壟斷審查與 Indonesia GoTo 併購反壟斷疑慮均屬未決（方向中性偏負）；Malaysia MyCC 舊案已於 2025-03 對 Grab 有利終結（正向）。

reg_tariff_export.note: 三輪搜尋（Section 232、出口管制實體清單、中國關稅曝險）均查無任何將 Grab 與關稅或出口管制直接連結的具體報導；僅查到與 Grab 無關的一般性 2026 關稅政策背景新聞（如美中關稅休兵、Section 232 鋼鋁銅調整）。Grab 為東南亞叫車／外送／金融科技服務平台，未見報導指其business涉及受管制實體商品跨境貿易或出口管制曝險。
